preCopy.value: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 python3-pip python3-dev python-is-python3 git curl ca-certificates libgl1 libglib2.0-0 cuda-nvrtc-11-8=11.8.89-1 cuda-nvrtc-dev-11-8=11.8.89-1 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

git clone https://github.com/CAMMA-public/UltraSam.git /opt/ultrasam && git -C /opt/ultrasam checkout ff3157b1fca8b1d963d9138372768e1fecad71e9 && mkdir -p /opt/nuclio/checkpoints && curl --fail --location --retry 8 --retry-all-errors --continue-at - https://s3.unistra.fr/camma_public/github/ultrasam/UltraSam.pth -o /opt/nuclio/checkpoints/UltraSam.pth

postCopy.value: python -m pip check && python /opt/nuclio/validate_build.py && python -m pip freeze > /opt/nuclio/build-requirements.txt
